label: signalled deaths (SIGKILL/SIGTERM) stop being recognised, so a container OOM is reported to the user as their build failing
the in-sandbox timeout exit code is no longer recognised, so a timeout is reported as a build failure with no retry
bool exit codes are coerced instead of rejected, so build_exit=False deploys an unbuilt site

label: an unknown sentinel schema is trusted instead of refused, so field meanings are guessed at
the empty-artifact check is removed, so a build that emits nothing deploys a blank site with every step reporting success
the timeout is sized on build alone, dropping the cold install that this lane pays on every build
the timeout floor is dropped, so a small measurement produces a budget below the known cold-install cost
the project-root guard is removed, so html tars '.' and silently ships a node_modules-laden artifact
the trap is registered AFTER the install, so a failing install writes no sentinel and is misclassified as infrastructure loss
